expected_response.note: Incumbent preserved; no registered bounded declarative edit expresses the supported short-range pair-kernel or joint-internal direction, and temporal conditioning is not supported by the supplied curves.

failure_modes: Selecting a region_index or temporal_region_index edit on the strength of landmark softmin point estimates whose positive_batch_fraction is 0.0-0.86 and whose adjusted q does not survive (endpoint_effects:14,20,32,68) would over-prioritize batch-inconsistent evidence.
Extending the short-range pair-kernel direction to the 7.0 A shell would contradict the sign flip and loss of batch agreement at endpoint_effects:13 and branch_adjusted:167.

Treating the turnover residual as a causal selection effect or atom velocity would misread an accounting diagnostic that includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting (turnover:1,2,14,17).

Treating recorded descendant joint-head credit as final affinity benefit would be unsupported because decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable and ancestral coverage is thin (lineage_support).
Proposing any temperature change would violate the immutable fixed-parameter policy (fixed_parameters).
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible coordinate signal is the short-range pair-kernel shell family (endpoint_effects:9-11 with positive_batch_fraction 1.0; branch_adjusted:86,87,163,164 surviving BH at q<0.05), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no registered bounded edit maps that diagnostic onto the operative reward. The permitted edits are pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index and temporal_teacher_blend; none of these is a pair-kernel or joint-internal-RMS control, and the Analyst's own hypothesis 1 is a diagnostic priority rather than a registered design. The counterexample at the 7.0 A shell (endpoint_effects:13 integrated z=-0.485, positive_batch_fraction 0.0; branch_adjusted:167 negative) shows the short-range direction is not safely extendable, and the joint internal-RMS family (branch_adjusted:228,230,305,307; joint_diagnostics:14 internal fraction 0.787) is likewise a coupling diagnostic with no operative handle. Temporal conditioning is unsupported: every continuous function is an observed-node linear interpolant with extrapolation_allowed=false, polynomial_accepted=false throughout, and frequent sign changes (continuous_functions, curve_support), so a temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit would not be evidence-bound. Descendant credit cannot arbitrate because decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false and lineage_support shows thin ancestral coverage (349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors, 531 with fewer than 6, of 700), so the recorded survival enrichment is survivor-conditioned. With no defensible expected advantage over the incumbent and no registered edit that expresses the supported direction, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; temperatures remain fixed and no temperature edit is proposed.
